response.overview: A cat has an empty cart.  Whether in a cafe or on the street, wherever she is, there is always a cart by her side. It's not just a cart  Maybe it's our unforgettable obsession with her A cart has collapsed on the road. She is also lying next to the cart.  And she opens and closes her eyes slightly  where is she heading where are we headed Can we throw away our own carts?  While she was walking and pulling the cart  The sounds of life and the scenes of a revolving lantern collide in a montage.  And it shows the receipts you have used so far.
response.title: A WOMAN WHO PULLS A CART AND RECEIPT
